privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must model 3 technologies. Expected results should fall within these ranges: Annual Energy Production (AEP) between 90,000 and 160,000 MWh; Capacity Factor (CF) between 22.0% and 35.0%; Real LCOE between $20.0/MWh and $80.0/MWh. The specific weather file to be used is daggett_ca_34.865371_-116.783023_psmv3_60_tmy.csv. Tech B (HJT) will likely have the highest energy yield due to the low temperature coefficient, while Tech C (CdTe) will likely have the lowest module cost.
